WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.TITLE: Templates & Flows
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.DESCRIPTION: View the message templates of your WhatsApp inboxes. Administrators can create, edit and delete templates on WhatsApp Cloud channels.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.SYNC_SUCCESS: Template sync started for all WhatsApp inboxes. Updates may take a couple of minutes.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.PARTIAL_SYNC_ERROR: Template sync started for some WhatsApp inboxes, but others could not be synced.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.SYNC_ERROR: Unable to start template sync. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.FETCH_ERROR: Unable to load WhatsApp templates. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.PARTIAL_FETCH_ERROR: Some WhatsApp templates could not be loaded. Please try again.

PREVIEW.TITLE: Template preview
PREVIEW.DESCRIPTION: Preview how this template appears in WhatsApp.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.NO_CLOUD_CHANNEL: You need a WhatsApp Cloud channel to create templates.

FORM.DESCRIPTION: Meta reviews every template before it can be used. The preview updates as you type.
FORM.CANNOT_EDIT_NOW: Meta only allows editing approved, rejected or paused templates. Wait for the review to finish.
FORM.NAME: Name

UTILITY.LABEL: Utility
UTILITY.HELP: Confirmations, reminders and notices about something the customer already did or asked for.

MARKETING.LABEL: Marketing
MARKETING.HELP: Promotions, news and re-engagement. Meta usually charges more per message. Meta may change the category when it reviews.

FORM.CATEGORY_LOCKED: An approved template cannot change category.
FORM.MEDIA_HEADER_UNAVAILABLE: Image, video or document headers are not available on this channel from ChatHub. You can use a text header.
FORM.BODY_PLACEHOLDER: Hi, a reminder of your appointment tomorrow.
FORM.ADD_VARIABLE: Add a variable to the body

RULES.TITLE: Meta rules
RULES.REVIEW: Every new or edited template goes back to review before it can be used.
RULES.EDIT_LIMITS: An approved template can be edited up to 10 times in 30 days and once every 24 hours.
RULES.CATEGORY: The category cannot be changed once the template is approved.
RULES.DELETE_LOCK: When you delete it, the name and language stay locked for 30 days.
RULES.LIMIT: There is a limit of 250 templates per account while the business is not verified.

FORM.CREATED: Template sent to Meta for review.
FORM.UPDATED: Changes sent to Meta for review.
FORM.SAVE_ERROR: The template could not be saved. Please try again.

ERRORS.NAME_INVALID: The name can only contain lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
ERRORS.HEADER_TEXT_TOO_LONG: The header can have up to {headerLimit} characters.
ERRORS.HEADER_ONE_VARIABLE: The header supports a single variable: {variable}.
ERRORS.HEADER_MEDIA_REQUIRED: Upload the example file for the header.
ERRORS.BODY_TOO_LONG: The body can have up to {bodyLimit} characters.
ERRORS.VARIABLE_AT_EDGE: The body cannot start or end with a variable.
ERRORS.FOOTER_TOO_LONG: The footer can have up to {footerLimit} characters.
ERRORS.FOOTER_NO_VARIABLES: The footer does not support variables.
ERRORS.BUTTON_TEXT_TOO_LONG: A button text can have up to {buttonLimit} characters.
ERRORS.URL_INVALID: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
ERRORS.URL_VARIABLE_AT_END: The URL accepts one variable at the end.
ERRORS.TOO_MANY_BUTTONS: You can add up to {buttonsLimit} buttons.
ERRORS.TOO_MANY_URL_BUTTONS: You can add up to {urlLimit} link buttons.
ERRORS.TOO_MANY_PHONE_BUTTONS: You can add only {phoneLimit} call button.
ERRORS.VARIABLES_MIXED: Do not mix named and numbered variables.
ERRORS.VARIABLE_NAME_INVALID: A variable name can only have lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, and must start with a letter.
ERRORS.COPY_CODE_MARKETING_ONLY: The copy code button can only be used in Marketing templates.
ERRORS.COPY_CODE_REQUIRED: Enter the code the button copies.
ERRORS.COPY_CODE_TOO_LONG: The code can have up to {codeLimit} characters.
ERRORS.TOO_MANY_COPY_CODE: You can only add one copy code button.
ERRORS.EDIT_STRUCTURE_LOCKED: Keep the components and the number and order of variables. Create a copy to change them.
ERRORS.SYSTEM_MAPPING_REQUIRED: Map each number to a different variable before creating the copy.
ERRORS.COPY_NAME_REQUIRED: The copy needs a different name from the original template.
ERRORS.URL_EXAMPLE_INVALID: Use a full URL with the same prefix and a value replacing the variable.

FORM.PROMO_WARNING: This text sounds promotional ({words}). Meta will probably classify it as Marketing, which costs more per message. If it is a promotion, choose Marketing; if not, remove those words.
FORM.CATEGORY_CHANGED: Meta classified the template as {assigned} instead of {requested}. The price per message changes.
FORM.VARIABLES_NAMED_HELP: Recommended: each variable says what it is, and Captain fills them in by name.
FORM.VARIABLES_POSITIONAL_HELP: Numbered variables, in order. Use them if the template already exists that way in Meta.
FORM.COPY_CODE_PLACEHOLDER: Code that gets copied (for example PALU21)
FORM.COPY_CODE_HELP: Meta writes the button label ("Copy offer code"). Up to 15 characters.
FORM.PRESERVED: Kept exactly as it is in Meta: {parts}. It cannot be edited from here.
FORM.EXAMPLES: Example of each variable (Meta asks for it to review the template)
FORM.PREVIEW_HELP: This is how the customer will see it, with the variable examples.

MEDIA_HEADER_REASONS.app_not_found: The Meta app of this channel could not be found, so images, videos and documents cannot be uploaded to the header. You can use a text header.
MEDIA_HEADER_REASONS.upload_refused: Meta does not let this channel access upload example files. You can use a text header.

FORM.SYSTEM_COPY_HELP: Choose a variable for each number; the old template keeps working until Meta approves the copy.
FORM.APPROVED_WARNING: Meta allows 1 edit per 24 hours and 10 in 30 days. Name and language cannot change; saving sends the template back to review and it may become pending or paused.
FORM.EDIT_STRUCTURE_HELP: You can edit text while keeping the components and variables in the same order.

DELETE_DIALOG.TITLE: Delete template
DELETE_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: Delete the template {name} ({language})? It is deleted only in that language; the other versions of the same name are kept.
DELETE_DIALOG.LOCK_NOTE: Meta locks that name and language for 30 days: you will not be able to create the same template until then.
DELETE_DIALOG.ERROR: The template could not be deleted. Please try again.

PRESETS.TITLE: Preset templates
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Pick one, adjust it if you like and send it to Meta for review. Nothing is sent until you save it.

CATEGORY_NOTE.UTILITY: Utility: notifies or confirms something the customer already asked for.
CATEGORY_NOTE.MARKETING: Marketing: invites the customer back or to continue; Meta charges more per message.

PRESETS.DISABLED_FORMS: Available once you can create WhatsApp forms.

recordatorio_cita.TITLE: Appointment reminder
recordatorio_cita.DESCRIPTION: Reminds of the appointment and asks to confirm, change the time or cancel.

confirmar_asistencia_cita.TITLE: Confirm attendance
confirmar_asistencia_cita.DESCRIPTION: Asks whether the customer can attend the appointment.

cita_cancelada.TITLE: Appointment cancelled
cita_cancelada.DESCRIPTION: Tells the appointment was cancelled and offers to book another.

cita_cambiada.TITLE: Appointment changed
cita_cambiada.DESCRIPTION: Tells the new day and time of the appointment.

reenganche_conversacion.TITLE: Resume a conversation
reenganche_conversacion.DESCRIPTION: Invites the customer to continue a pending conversation.

seguimiento_cotizacion.TITLE: Information or quote follow-up
seguimiento_cotizacion.DESCRIPTION: Asks whether the customer reviewed what you sent.

seguimiento_servicio.TITLE: Follow-up after the service
seguimiento_servicio.DESCRIPTION: Asks for the customer's opinion after the service.

datos_cliente.TITLE: Customer data
datos_cliente.DESCRIPTION: Asks for the customer's data with a WhatsApp form.

LIBRARY.TITLE: Meta library
LIBRARY.DESCRIPTION: Utility templates already written by Meta. The text is fixed; you only choose the name and the data their buttons ask for.
LIBRARY.EMPTY: No library templates for this search or language.
LIBRARY.ERROR: The Meta library could not be read. Please try again.
LIBRARY.ERROR_DETAIL: The Meta library could not be read: {message}
LIBRARY.ALL_LANGUAGES: Showing library templates in all available languages.

DIALOG.TITLE: Create from the library
DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: It is created with Meta's text and goes to review.
DIALOG.NAME: Template name
DIALOG.URL_SUFFIX: Example of the variable part of the link
DIALOG.ERROR: The template could not be created. Please try again.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.DUPLICATE_FLOW_BODY: Create "{name}" as a draft without publications.
